name: (02) Serpentis — 1 Basic — The Tongue of the Asp

system.description:
At will your tongue lengthens and forks into that of a snake, its supernatural razor-edge able to lash out and open terrible wounds — and to drink.

You need only decide to use the power. The tongue strikes up to a foot and a half away, inflicting one aggravated wound on a successful Physical Challenge (retest Subterfuge); on successive turns you may drain blood from the victim as if drinking directly, delivering the paralyzing Kiss to mortal victims. The forked tongue is highly sensitive to vibration, reducing the penalty Traits for natural darkness by one.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
